newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel suspends East Jerusalem building permit.
newsitem.headline: Israel suspends East Jerusalem building permit.

text.p: Israel's Interior Ministry said on Monday it had suspended a permit granted for construction of a Jewish enclave in Arab East Jerusalem pending an appeal filed against the plan.

"The appeals committee decided the permit cannot be granted until a ruling is made on the appeal," Interior Ministry spokewoman Tova Ellinson told Reuters, adding the appeal would probably be heard on August 8.
The news last week that Jerusalem's municipality had authorised the project at Ras al-Amoud outraged Palestinians who claim East Jerusalem as the capital of a future Palestinian state.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said he is working to block the plan "at this time".

Jerusalem Mayor Ehud Olmert confirmed that U.S. businessman Irving Moskowitz, who bought the land and received a permit to build about 70 homes for Jews, could not start work until a ruling was made on the appeal.
"If there was an appeal, the appeal needs to be discussed entirely. Until the appeal is discussed, the owner of the permit cannot implement it," he told Israel's army radio.
